name: needs-setup-state
title: Needs setup state
description: Stands in for a feature that needs one step first: what is missing, why, the steps done and left, and the action that fixes it.
docs: title says what is needed, as the action it asks for, and description says why. steps is a list of { label, done }: a finished step shows a check and the word Done, the first open step is marked Next and carries aria-current="step", the rest are read out as not done, and a polite status says how many are finished. actionLabel and onAction make the main button; if onAction returns a promise the button shows a spinner and ignores presses until it settles, without losing focus. secondary is a node beside it, such as a link. minHeight is the height of the feature the panel stands in for, in pixels or any CSS length, so the page does not jump when setup finishes. icon replaces the plug. Use it for one missing prerequisite that blocks one specific thing, not for onboarding. labels carries every word.
